phrases.latin: Ōs aperī; hiā quam maximē potes. Dīc ‘ā’.
phrases.english: Open your mouth; open as wide as you can. Say “aah”.

phrases.latin: trochilos crocodīlum invītat ad hiandum pābulī suī grātiā
phrases.english: the little wren invites the crocodile to open wide, to get its own food (it picks his teeth)

sources: Lewis & Short: os · Lewis & Short: hio · Lewis & Short: aperio · Lewis & Short: trochilus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 58.
